title: The Border Post — Zimbabwe (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage diaspora migration identity
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The border post between the life you had and the life you're going to
Is not always a building with a stamp and something to go through
Sometimes it's a flight, a morning, a decision made at dawn
Sometimes it's a conversation after which the old has gone

[Chorus]
The border post, the border post
Standing between two countries and two kinds of belonging
The border post, the border post
The stamp on the page says yes but something's still ongoing
The border post knows you're carrying more than what's declared
The border post knows what's in the bag that you prepared

[Verse 2]
You queue with everything you own reduced to what is portable
And everything you're leaving is the part that's not affordable
The customs officer asks the purpose of your visit here
And the purpose is a whole life — that doesn't quite fit the field clear

[Bridge]
Twenty years later and the border post is in the memory only
The children were born on this side — the other side seems lonely
But not quite — because the other side is in the music too
The border post is where two versions of yourself pass through

[Outro]
The border post knows… two countries in one chest… the crossing knows…
The gardens still growing
